about: Each of Agent Link's own tools as FreeCAD files it: workbench (FreeCAD's workbench class name, null for none), commands (the FreeCAD commands the tool does the work of) and words (search words its name lacks). Generated by scripts/tool_index.py from agentlink/echo.py and scripts/tool_index_more.py: edit those, not this. Command names are FreeCAD's (1.1). An add-on gives the same three fields in its own tools.json entries.
